name: Jersey Finger
definition: Avulsion of the flexor digitorum profundus tendon from the distal phalanx, classically during forced extension of an actively flexed finger.

investigations.principle: Radiographs assess avulsion fragment; ultrasound/MRI is selective.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, vascular, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Early surgical repair is usually required for complete FDP avulsion.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Anguli-Snayu avulsion phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Avulsion of the flexor digitorum profundus tendon from the distal phalanx, classically during forced extension of an actively flexed finger.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe vascular symptoms, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, sphincter change or other listed red flags.
